patterns.description: Cards que co-ocurren con la figura '10%' aplicada a Gumroad fees desde distintas fuentes: SC-R1-005 (pricing_page), SC-R1-032 (help_center, July 2023), SC-R1-033 (help_center, July 2024 — affiliates), SC-R1-035 (help_center, undated). SC-R1-033 describe el 10% como comisión de afiliados, no la plataforma fee — mismo vocabulario, fenómeno diferente.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-005: Gumroad pricing page: 10% + $0.50 per transaction (platform fee on standard sales)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-032: Gumroad help center: 10% flat fee per sale (platform fee)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-035: Gumroad help center: 10% flat fee for sales on Gumroad website (platform fee, truncated)
signal_summaries.SC-R1-033: Gumroad help center: affiliates earn fixed 10% commission per sale (affiliate commission, not platform fee)

patterns.routing_rationale: SC-R1-005, SC-R1-032, SC-R1-035 share the '10%' figure as the platform transaction fee — possible dedup across different help center articles about the same policy. SC-R1-033 uses '10%' for a different mechanism (affiliate commission). No explicit friction between these cards — all document policies consistently. Route to rejected_grouping with note 'possible dedup (SC-R1-005, SC-R1-032, SC-R1-035) and vocabulary coincidence (SC-R1-033 different mechanism).'

components.label: Overlap group — figura 10% en fees de plataforma
components.summary: Three platform cards documenting 10% as Gumroad's standard transaction fee from different source documents

components.label: Vocabulary coincidence — figura 10% en comisión de afiliados
components.summary: Same 10% figure used for affiliate commission — different mechanism, same number

patterns.description: Cards que comparten vocabulario sobre 'zero' tráfico/vistas/ventas orgánicas en Gumroad: SC-R1-049 ('zero footfall'), SC-R1-062 ('zero organic views'), SC-R1-048 ('views do not equate to dollars'). Tres sellers describiendo el mismo fenómeno de ausencia de tráfico orgánico desde distintos posts de blog.

signal_summaries.SC-R1-049: Seller with 35 listings: zero organic traffic ('zero footfall'), blog March 2026
signal_summaries.SC-R1-062: Seller with 26 products: zero organic views and zero Discover views, forum post March 2026
signal_summaries.SC-R1-048: Seller: traffic metrics (views) on Gumroad do not equate to dollars in sales, blog September 2025

patterns.routing_rationale: Three seller cards describing the same phenomenon (zero or ineffective organic traffic) from different sources and dates. This is a deduplication signal: these cards likely document the same underlying platform behavior from different seller perspectives. No explicit friction between the cards themselves — they are consistent. Route to rejected_grouping with note 'possible dedup — same phenomenon documented by multiple sellers.' Already captured in ASY-002 and OPD-001 as evidence of the blocked pole.

components.label: Overlap group — sellers reportando cero tráfico orgánico
components.summary: Three seller cards documenting absence of organic/Discover traffic from different sources and dates

patterns.description: Cards que comparten vocabulario sobre '90 days' en el contexto de Gumroad refund/chargeback policies: SC-R1-034 (help_center) documenta refund window de 90 días; SC-R1-037 (help_center) documenta chargeback window de 'usually 90 days.' Mismo período, dos mecanismos distintos (seller-initiated refund vs buyer-initiated chargeback).

signal_summaries.SC-R1-034: Gumroad help center: platform reserves right to issue refunds within 90 days of purchase
signal_summaries.SC-R1-037: Gumroad help center: customers have usually 90 days from date of sale to request a chargeback through their bank

patterns.routing_rationale: Both cards share the '90 days' timeframe but document different mechanisms: SC-R1-034 is about platform-initiated refunds (Gumroad's right), SC-R1-037 is about buyer-initiated chargebacks (bank right). Both have actor=platform. No explicit friction between the cards — they describe two different but possibly overlapping exposure windows for sellers. Route to rejected_grouping with note 'vocabulary coincidence (90 days) — different mechanisms, possible dedup awareness for refund/chargeback cluster.'

components.label: Overlap — período de 90 días en refunds y chargebacks
components.summary: Both cards cite 90-day window but for different mechanisms: platform refund right vs buyer chargeback right
